instruction: Place an order for everything in my amazon cart and wishlist for my home address.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The wish list contents are unknown before runtime, so the problem instantiates placeholder products wish-product-1..3 (one per wish list entry; the agent instantiates as many as show_wish_list returns, each moved with one move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart call, which by default moves the entry's full quantity). The cart's existing products need no API call so they are not modeled as objects; show_cart is kept as the knowledge step confirming what is being ordered. Ordering is enforced structurally: moving wish list items is only allowed while (not (order-placed)), so every (in-cart wish-product-i) goal must be achieved before amazon-place-order, which in turn must precede supervisor-complete-task. place_order requires the address satisfying (is-home-address ?ad) (address_id of the address named Home from show_addresses) and any payment card; the goal predicate (ordered-to-home) records the delivery address constraint in a nullary form so complete-task's precondition can reference it. No existing address is modified or deleted (only lookups).
